thought.text: The auto-created polls have nil dates. Let me make the shifts section skip polls without dates.

reasoning_content: So each VotingPhase auto-creates a poll with nil dates. Those polls (6-10) have nil starts_at/ends_at. The Poll Shifts section iterates over ALL polls including those. I should make the shifts section skip polls without dates. Let me patch.

action.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PY'
p="db/dev_seeds/polls.rb"
s=open(p).read()
old='''  Poll.find_each do |poll|
    Poll::BoothAssignment.where(poll: poll).each do |booth_assignment|
      scrutiny = (poll.ends_at.to_datetime..poll.ends_at.to_datetime + Poll::RECOUNT_DURATION)'''
new='''  Poll.find_each do |poll|
    next if poll.starts_at.blank? || poll.ends_at.blank?

    Poll::BoothAssignment.where(poll: poll).each do |booth_assignment|
      scrutiny = (poll.ends_at.to_datetime..poll.ends_at.to_datetime + Poll::RECOUNT_DURATION)'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("patched")
PY
